body:
## Problem

The default 'ruler' is implemented in C instead of the 'statusline' DSL.
Users cannot take the default as a starting point for customisation.

## Solution

Replace the C implementation with a default 'rulerformat' expression.

Based on the decisions made in #33036. In particular, the main breaking change is that 'rulerformat' cannot be set empty anymore. Since configuring 'rulerformat' is likely less popular than 'statusline', I expect fewer problems like #33576 or #38670.

The default ruler now has a consistent width, no matter where it is displayed. See #41076 for details.

Closes #41076

comment_data.body: My initial intention behind the first refactoring commit was to clean up `redraw_ruler` in order to make the changes in the following commit a little more straightforward. But because `win_redr_stl_expr` had similar and related problems, I refactored it in the same commit. I also think that, as this function gets more important, it helps to have a clearer separation between the code paths of all the different cases. That said, I found the previous version hard to reason about and the changes are not trivial, but also not necessary for this PR.

Just a nit, but the wording seems a bit confusing as now it cannot be empty and always determines the content of ruler string.

```suggestion
	This option determines the content of the ruler string, as displayed
	for the 'ruler' option.
```
